left.title: Sidebar
left.desc: Hides ad banners and widgets in the left column

api.title: Ads in posts · API
api.desc: Removes ads and posts matching your keywords from the feed, communities, profiles and search

dom.title: Also filter the page · DOM
dom.desc: Hides posts on the page using your keyword lists

trackers.title: Tracker blocking
trackers.desc: Intercepts analytics, telemetry and ad networks

keywords.nav_desc: One set of lists for API and DOM
keywords.page_subtitle: Shared keyword lists for API and DOM
keywords.help: Words and phrases match without case sensitivity, including within words. Exceptions override stop words. Built-in API ad blocking stays active. Changes apply immediately to the DOM and new API data; reload the page to fetch posts previously removed by the API filter.

stats.empty: Statistics will appear here after you enable the blockers

protection.title: Core protection
protection.desc: Ads in posts, banners and data collection

keywords.title: Your keyword filter
keywords.hint: Your keyword lists work in the API filter. DOM also applies them to posts on the page and does not affect the protection level.

reload.title: Reload the VK page?
reload.enabled: The API filter is enabled. Reload VK to apply it to posts already loaded on the page.
reload.disabled: The API filter is disabled. Reload VK to fetch posts it previously removed.
reload.hint: Your setting is saved. You can reload now or do it later.
reload.failed: Could not reload VK. Open the VK tab you need and reload it manually.

content.title: Ads and recommendations by section
content.subtitle: Choose which blocks to hide
content.description: An enabled switch hides the listed blocks. Turn it off to show them again. Each section is independent; hiding is enabled everywhere by default. Changes apply immediately on the open VK page.

block_recommendations_feed.title: Feed
block_recommendations_feed.desc: Hides recommended channels and communities and the Yandex Browser banner in the feed.

block_recommendations_games.title: Games
block_recommendations_games.desc: Hides recommended games and the promotional banner in the games catalog.

block_recommendations_market.title: Market
block_recommendations_market.desc: Hides the “You may be interested” product collection in Market.

block_recommendations_calls.title: Calls
block_recommendations_calls.desc: Hides the promotional banner in the calls section.

block_recommendations_profile.title: Profile menu
block_recommendations_profile.desc: Hides the promotional banner in the profile dropdown, including its tooltip and close button.

block_recommendations_messenger.title: Messenger
block_recommendations_messenger.desc: Hides the Yandex Browser banner above the conversation list.

block_music_ads.title: Music
block_music_ads.desc: Hides VK Music banners and promotions, and blocks spoken audio ads between tracks.

block_recommendations_communities.title: Communities
block_recommendations_communities.desc: Hides the “Similar communities” block and the element immediately after it on community pages.

block_yandex_browser_promo.title: Yandex Browser in the menu
block_yandex_browser_promo.desc: Hides the Yandex Browser promotional item in VK’s left menu. Feed and messenger banners have separate switches.

content.nav_desc: Recommendations, banners and promotional menu items across VK
